app_release_notes: v1.17.5 - Range & DOPE now remembers the temperature and altitude you set, and your printed DOPE card uses them too. Starting a different kind of test now asks one clear question, and brings your bullet along to the new load. Plus fixes and improvements.

windows.app_release_notes: v1.17.4 - Adding your chronograph or target data to a load you already started no longer asks if it's a new test. The DOPE card shows energy in joules when your speeds are in meters per second. Plainer wording in the Results winner notes. Starting a different kind of test on a load now offers a clean new load. Plus fixes and improvements.
